caption: The drawing depicts a garment-like object composed of a textured, basket-weave patterned fabric in an off-white or light beige color. The object is shaped roughly like an inverted triangle with two wide straps extending upwards and outwards from the top corners. Each strap and the edges of the main triangle are bordered with a delicate lace trim. Along the borders, a light blue ribbon is threaded through the lace, forming a decorative detail. Three large, prominent bows made from the same light blue ribbon are present: one at the end of each strap and one at the tip of the triangle at the bottom. The background is plain and uncolored, highlighting the central textile object.
title: Infant's Bib
